name: Human Fighter
notes: Base table §1, the same for all six lines.
Levels 1-4: auto-attack only (no attack skill yet), any weapon.
AoE / toggles / buffs: none in this band.

Weapon choice by future line: Duelist / Dreadnought / knights: sword (knights + shield) → Power Strike. Adventurer: dagger → Mortal Blow. Sagittarius: bow → Power Shot. Pick the skill from the EQUIPPED weapon (R1).
Party role: everyone is a melee/ranged DD. The future knight can already hold monsters with its sword + shield, but has no aggro skill until 24.

rows.trig: Spam (3 s, 30 MP). It's a blow (blowChance 20): it lands more often from the side or behind.
Opener from range, then on cooldown (6 s, 67 MP: heavy MP for level 5-19, keep it as the opener only).
rows.why: Guide aspect: single target; its rule makes it the opener only (MP cost).
